note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The case file is shown in the state its routes were marked with (as supplied); a lens enlarges one route's end card and the last leg of its track, and only the end entry printed on that card is substituted by the supplied alternative. No track, clip, badge or state changes; no finality doctrine, and nothing says whether any route is closed or available. Brief fields: decisions, grounds, routes, outcomes, focusTarget, beforeValue, afterValue, detailGeometry and contextLabels are editable.
